The '''Iscno system''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Iscno [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]'s [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square K-12.<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with "Iscno,"<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|60|Inside Attack of the Clones|Inside ''Attack of the Clones''}}</ref> a misspelling of the name of<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|ronetcoorr|Coorr, Ronet}}</ref><ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|118|Iseno}}</ref> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iseno/Legends|Iseno]].<ref name="CSWE" />
